mechanism_narrative: A 30-day decline in FEDFUNDS compresses discount rates and reduces risk premiums, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns. The signal is the 30-day change in FEDFUNDS.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS declines by >0.1% in 30 days (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS exceeding 4.5% signals restrictive monetary policy, suppressing equity valuations and causing negative 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 2.0% signal an overheating economy triggering Fed tightening, leading to negative 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 2.0% (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, a decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) signals an imminent slowdown, causing negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 growth rate (qoq) < 1.5% (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising UNRATE signals economic weakness and reduced corporate earnings, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE rises by >0.1% in 30 days (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE exceeding 5.5% signals a severe economic downturn, causing negative 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 5.5% (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE > 5.0% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5% signal Fed rate cuts to stimulate the economy, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE > 5.0% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime, INDPRO growth rate (qoq) < -0.5% signals a recessionary supply shock, causing negative 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO growth rate (qoq) < -0.5% (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
